name: Finalize Dependabot PR 931

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/finalize-pr931-20260908-v4

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  checks: read
  actions: write
  security-events: read

jobs:
  finalize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
      PR_NUMBER: '931'
      HEAD_BRANCH: security/dependabot-zero-audit-main-20260908-v3
      COMPLETION_TAG: dependabot-remediation-2026-09-08-complete
      AUTOMATION_REF: heads/automation/finalize-pr931-20260908-v4
    steps:
      - name: Ensure CI runs, merge through core, and verify alert closure
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rerun_used=0
          reopen_used=0

          normalize_pr() {
            local merged state base
            merged="$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" --jq '.merged')"
            if [[ "$merged" == 'true' ]]; then
              return 0
            fi
            state="$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" --jq '.state')"
            base="$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" --jq '.base.ref')"
            if [[ "$state" != 'open' || "$base" != 'main' ]]; then
              gh api --method PATCH "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" \
                -f state=open -f base=main \
                -f title='fix(security): resolve all Dependabot alerts' >/dev/null
            fi
            gh pr merge "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPOSITORY" --auto --squash || true
          }

          trigger_pr_ci() {
            gh api --method PATCH "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" -f state=closed >/dev/null
            sleep 3
            gh api --method PATCH "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" \
              -f state=open -f base=main >/dev/null
          }

          normalize_pr

          for attempt in $(seq 1 120); do
            pr_json="$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}")"
            merged="$(jq -r '.merged' <<<"$pr_json")"
            state="$(jq -r '.state' <<<"$pr_json")"
            head_sha="$(jq -r '.head.sha' <<<"$pr_json")"
            base_ref="$(jq -r '.base.ref' <<<"$pr_json")"

            if [[ "$merged" == 'true' ]]; then
              main_sha="$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/branches/main" --jq '.commit.sha')"
              set +e
              alerts_json="$(gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
                "repos/${REPOSITORY}/dependabot/alerts?state=open&per_page=100" \
                --paginate --slurp 2>"${RUNNER_TEMP}/dependabot-alerts.err")"
              alerts_exit="$?"
              set -e
              if [[ "$alerts_exit" -ne 0 ]]; then
                cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/dependabot-alerts.err" >&2
                exit "$alerts_exit"
              fi
              open_count="$(jq '[.[][]] | length' <<<"$alerts_json")"
              echo "merged=true main=${main_sha} open_dependabot_alerts=${open_count}"
              if [[ "$open_count" -eq 0 ]]; then
                encoded_tag="${COMPLETION_TAG//\//%2F}"
                if gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/git/ref/tags/${encoded_tag}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                  gh api --method PATCH "repos/${REPOSITORY}/git/refs/tags/${encoded_tag}" \
                    -f sha="$main_sha" -F force=true >/dev/null
                else
                  gh api --method POST "repos/${REPOSITORY}/git/refs" \
                    -f ref="refs/tags/${COMPLETION_TAG}" -f sha="$main_sha" >/dev/null
                fi
                gh api --method DELETE "repos/${REPOSITORY}/git/refs/${AUTOMATION_REF}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
                echo "completion_tag=${COMPLETION_TAG} sha=${main_sha}"
                exit 0
              fi
              sleep 30
              continue
            fi

            if [[ "$state" != 'open' || "$base_ref" != 'main' ]]; then
              normalize_pr
              sleep 5
              continue
            fi

            checks_json="$(gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
              "repos/${REPOSITORY}/commits/${head_sha}/check-runs?per_page=100")"
            core_status="$(jq -r '[.check_runs[] | select(.name == "core" and .app.slug == "github-actions")] | sort_by(.started_at // .created_at) | last | .status // "missing"' <<<"$checks_json")"
            core_conclusion="$(jq -r '[.check_runs[] | select(.name == "core" and .app.slug == "github-actions")] | sort_by(.started_at // .created_at) | last | .conclusion // "pending"' <<<"$checks_json")"
            echo "attempt=${attempt} head=${head_sha} core_status=${core_status} core_conclusion=${core_conclusion}"

            if [[ "$core_status" == 'completed' && "$core_conclusion" == 'success' ]]; then
              gh pr merge "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPOSITORY" --squash \
                --subject 'fix(security): resolve all Dependabot alerts' \
                --body 'Resolves all audited dependency advisories and restores pnpm frozen-lockfile consistency.'
              sleep 5
              continue
            fi

            if [[ "$core_status" == 'completed' && "$core_conclusion" =~ ^(failure|cancelled|timed_out|action_required|startup_failure|stale)$ ]]; then
              latest_run_id="$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?branch=${HEAD_BRANCH}&event=pull_request&per_page=20" \
                --jq '.workflow_runs | sort_by(.created_at) | last | .id // empty')"
              if [[ -n "$latest_run_id" && "$rerun_used" -eq 0 ]]; then
                echo "rerunning failed CI run ${latest_run_id}"
                gh run rerun "$latest_run_id" --repo "$REPOSITORY"
                rerun_used=1
                sleep 30
                continue
              fi
              echo "Required core failed after recovery attempt: ${core_conclusion}" >&2
              latest_run_id="$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?branch=${HEAD_BRANCH}&event=pull_request&per_page=20" \
                --jq '.workflow_runs | sort_by(.created_at) | last | .id // empty')"
              if [[ -n "$latest_run_id" ]]; then
                gh run view "$latest_run_id" --repo "$REPOSITORY" --log-failed || true
              fi
              exit 1
            fi

            if [[ "$core_status" == 'missing' && "$attempt" -ge 4 && "$reopen_used" -eq 0 ]]; then
              echo 'No core check found; reopening PR to trigger pull_request CI.'
              trigger_pr_ci
              reopen_used=1
              sleep 30
              continue
            fi

            sleep 30
          done

          echo 'Finalization conditions were not met before timeout.' >&2
          exit 1

on:
  push:
    branches:

concurrency:
  group: one-shot-finalize-all-open-prs-20260908

jobs:
  finalize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 55
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - name: Repair CI execution state and merge every ready PR
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          repo="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          declare -A rerun_requested=()

          mark_ready_and_sync() {
            local pr="$1"
            local draft mergeable_state
            draft="$(gh api "repos/$repo/pulls/$pr" --jq '.draft')"
            if [[ "$draft" == "true" ]]; then
              gh pr ready "$pr" --repo "$repo"
            fi

            mergeable_state="$(gh api "repos/$repo/pulls/$pr" --jq '.mergeable_state')"
            if [[ "$mergeable_state" == "behind" ]]; then
              gh api --method PUT "repos/$repo/pulls/$pr/update-branch" >/dev/null || true
            fi
          }

          request_failed_reruns() {
            local checks_json="$1"
            local run_ids run_id
            run_ids="$(jq -r '
              .check_runs[]
              | select(.app.slug != "vercel")
              | select(.conclusion == "failure" or .conclusion == "timed_out" or .conclusion == "startup_failure" or .conclusion == "action_required")
              | .details_url
              | capture("/actions/runs/(?<id>[0-9]+)(/|$)").id
            ' <<<"$checks_json" | sort -u)"

            while IFS= read -r run_id; do
              [[ -z "$run_id" ]] && continue
              if [[ -z "${rerun_requested[$run_id]:-}" ]]; then
                gh api --method POST "repos/$repo/actions/runs/$run_id/rerun-failed-jobs" >/dev/null || \
                  gh api --method POST "repos/$repo/actions/runs/$run_id/rerun" >/dev/null || true
                rerun_requested[$run_id]=1
              fi
            done <<<"$run_ids"
          }

          for round in $(seq 1 165); do
            mapfile -t prs < <(gh api "repos/$repo/pulls?state=open&base=main&per_page=100" --jq '.[].number')
            if (( ${#prs[@]} == 0 )); then
              echo "No open PRs targeting main remain."
              exit 0
            fi

            made_progress=false
            for pr in "${prs[@]}"; do
              mark_ready_and_sync "$pr"

              state="$(gh api "repos/$repo/pulls/$pr" --jq '.state')"
              [[ "$state" != "open" ]] && continue

              sha="$(gh api "repos/$repo/pulls/$pr" --jq '.head.sha')"
              checks_json="$(gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' "repos/$repo/commits/$sha/check-runs?filter=latest&per_page=100")"

              core_state="$(jq -r '[.check_runs[] | select(.name == "core") | {status, conclusion}] | first // {status:"missing", conclusion:null} | "\(.status):\(.conclusion // "")"' <<<"$checks_json")"
              failed_count="$(jq '[.check_runs[] | select(.app.slug != "vercel") | select(.conclusion == "failure" or .conclusion == "timed_out" or .conclusion == "startup_failure" or .conclusion == "action_required")] | length' <<<"$checks_json")"
              pending_count="$(jq '[.check_runs[] | select(.app.slug != "vercel") | select(.status != "completed")] | length' <<<"$checks_json")"

              echo "PR #$pr head=$sha core=$core_state failed=$failed_count pending=$pending_count"

              if (( failed_count > 0 )); then
                request_failed_reruns "$checks_json"
                failed_names="$(jq -r '.check_runs[] | select(.app.slug != "vercel") | select(.conclusion == "failure" or .conclusion == "timed_out" or .conclusion == "startup_failure" or .conclusion == "action_required") | "- \(.name): \(.conclusion)"' <<<"$checks_json")"
                gh pr comment "$pr" --repo "$repo" --body $'CI 실패 실행을 재시도했습니다.\n\n'"$failed_names" >/dev/null || true
                made_progress=true
                continue
              fi

              if [[ "$core_state" == "completed:success" ]]; then
                title="$(gh api "repos/$repo/pulls/$pr" --jq '.title')"
                if gh api --method PUT "repos/$repo/pulls/$pr/merge" \
                  -f merge_method=squash \
                  -f commit_title="$title (#$pr)" \
                  --jq '.merged' | grep -qx true; then
                  echo "Merged PR #$pr."
                  made_progress=true
                  continue
                fi

                gh pr merge "$pr" --repo "$repo" --squash --auto >/dev/null || true
              fi
            done

            if [[ "$made_progress" == "false" ]]; then
              sleep 20
            else
              sleep 10
            fi
          done

          echo "::error::Open PRs remain after the bounded CI/merge loop."
          gh api "repos/$repo/pulls?state=open&base=main&per_page=100" --jq '.[] | "#\(.number) \(.title) head=\(.head.sha)"'
          exit 1

              )

                  print(f"Cancelling closed-PR run {run_id} from {branch}")
                  api(f"actions/runs/{run_id}/cancel", "POST")

    steps:
      - name: Preserve only the latest run of each workflow for the current PR head
        shell: bash
        run: |

          repo="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          self="$GITHUB_RUN_ID"

          pr_json="$(gh api \
            -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
            -H 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
            "repos/${repo}/pulls/${TARGET_PR}")"
          pr_state="$(jq -r '.state' <<<"$pr_json")"

          final_sha="$(jq -r '.head.sha' <<<"$pr_json")"
          test "$pr_state" = "open"
          echo "Final candidate: ${final_branch}@${final_sha}"

          candidates="$(mktemp)"
          keep_ids="$(mktemp)"
          for status in queued in_progress waiting pending requested; do
            gh api --paginate \
              -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
              -H 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
              "repos/${repo}/actions/runs?status=${status}&per_page=100" \

            $2 == branch && $3 == sha {
              name = $4
              if (($1 + 0) > (latest[name] + 0)) latest[name] = $1
            }
            END { for (name in latest) print latest[name] }
          ' "$candidates" | sort -n > "$keep_ids"

          echo "Protected latest run IDs:"
          cat "$keep_ids" || true

          cancelled=0
          preserved=0
          raced=0
          while IFS=$'\t' read -r run_id branch sha name status; do

            fi

                -f state=closed -f state_reason=completed >/dev/null
              sleep 0.15
            done
          }

          run_check() {
            local category="$1"
            shift
            local command="$*"
            echo "::group::${category}: ${command}"
            "$@"
            local status=$?
            echo "::endgroup::"
            if [[ $status -eq 0 ]]; then
              close_category "$category" "$command"
            else
              echo "::error title=${category} verification failed::${command} exited ${status}"
              failed=1
            fi
          }

          eval "$RUN_SCRIPT"
          exit "$failed"

    steps:
      - name: Generate, poll, and commit available autofixes
        shell: bash

          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p autofix

          gh api --paginate \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${API_VERSION}" \
            "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/code-scanning/alerts?state=open&ref=refs%2Fheads%2Fmain&per_page=100" \
            | jq -s 'add' > autofix/open-alerts.json

          jq -r '.[].number' autofix/open-alerts.json | sort -n > autofix/alert-numbers.txt
          : > autofix/generation.tsv
          : > autofix/status.tsv
          : > autofix/commit.tsv

          while IFS= read -r number; do
            [[ -n "$number" ]] || continue
            endpoint="repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/code-scanning/alerts/${number}/autofix"
            if response=$(gh api --method POST \
                -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
                -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${API_VERSION}" \
                "$endpoint" 2>&1); then

            else
              printf '%s\terror\t%s\n' "$number" "$(tr '\r\n\t' '   ' <<<"$response")" >> autofix/generation.tsv

          done < autofix/alert-numbers.txt

          for round in $(seq 1 90); do
            pending=0
            : > autofix/status.tsv
            while IFS= read -r number; do
              [[ -n "$number" ]] || continue
              endpoint="repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/code-scanning/alerts/${number}/autofix"
              if response=$(gh api \
                  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
                  -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${API_VERSION}" \

                pending|processing|queued|unknown) pending=$((pending + 1)) ;;
              esac
            done < autofix/alert-numbers.txt

            echo "AUTOFIX_POLL_ROUND=${round} PENDING=${pending}"
            if [[ "$pending" -eq 0 ]]; then
              break
            fi
            sleep 10
          done

          awk -F '\t' '$2 == "success" {print $1}' autofix/status.tsv | sort -n > autofix/successful.txt
          awk -F '\t' '$2 != "success" {print}' autofix/status.tsv > autofix/unavailable.tsv

          while IFS= read -r number; do
            [[ -n "$number" ]] || continue
            endpoint="repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/code-scanning/alerts/${number}/autofix/commits"
            message="fix(security): apply CodeQL autofix for alert #${number}"
            committed=false
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do
              if response=$(gh api --method POST \
                  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
                  -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${API_VERSION}" \
                  "$endpoint" \
                  -f target_ref="$TARGET_REF" \
                  -f message="$message" 2>&1); then
                sha=$(jq -r '.sha // ""' <<<"$response" 2>/dev/null || true)
                printf '%s\tcommitted\t%s\n' "$number" "$sha" >> autofix/commit.tsv
                committed=true
                break
              fi
              if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then sleep 5; fi
            done
            if [[ "$committed" != true ]]; then
              printf '%s\terror\t%s\n' "$number" "$(tr '\r\n\t' '   ' <<<"$response")" >> autofix/commit.tsv
            fi
          done < autofix/successful.txt

          echo "OPEN_ALERTS=$(wc -l < autofix/alert-numbers.txt)"
          echo "AUTOFIX_SUCCESS=$(wc -l < autofix/successful.txt)"
          echo "AUTOFIX_COMMITTED=$(awk -F '\t' '$2 == "committed" {count++} END {print count+0}' autofix/commit.tsv)"
          echo "AUTOFIX_COMMIT_ERRORS=$(awk -F '\t' '$2 == "error" {count++} END {print count+0}' autofix/commit.tsv)"
          echo "AUTOFIX_UNAVAILABLE=$(wc -l < autofix/unavailable.tsv)"
          echo "AUTOFIX_COMMIT_RESULTS_BEGIN"
          cat autofix/commit.tsv
          echo "AUTOFIX_COMMIT_RESULTS_END"
          echo "AUTOFIX_UNAVAILABLE_BEGIN"
          cat autofix/unavailable.tsv
          echo "AUTOFIX_UNAVAILABLE_END"

      - name: Upload autofix report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: code-scanning-autofix-report
          path: autofix
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

name: Dependabot main remediation v2

on:

jobs:
  remediate:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Check out current main dependency graph
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: security/dependabot-main-remediation-20260908-v2
          fetch-depth: 2
          filter: blob:none
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            .npmrc
            package.json
            pnpm-lock.yaml
            pnpm-workspace.yaml
            apps/*/package.json
            packages/*/package.json
            patches/**
            .github/workflows/dependabot-main-remediation-v2.yml

      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          version: 11.4.0
          run_install: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Resolve every available advisory
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/dependabot-main-remediation"
          mkdir -p "$root"

          set +e
          pnpm audit --json --audit-level low > "$root/before.json" 2> "$root/before.err"
          printf '%s\n' "$?" > "$root/before.exit"

          pnpm audit --fix=update --audit-level low > "$root/fix.log" 2>&1
          printf '%s\n' "$?" > "$root/fix.exit"

          pnpm audit --json --audit-level low > "$root/after.json" 2> "$root/after.err"
          printf '%s\n' "$?" > "$root/after.exit"
          set -e

      - name: Require zero advisories at every severity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
          import { join } from "node:path";

          const root = join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, "dependabot-main-remediation");
          const readJson = (name) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, name), "utf8"));
          const readExit = (name) => Number(readFileSync(join(root, name), "utf8").trim());
          const counts = (report) => {
            const source = report?.metadata?.vulnerabilities ?? {};
            const result = Object.fromEntries(
              ["info", "low", "moderate", "high", "critical"].map((severity) => [
                severity,
                Number(source[severity] ?? 0),
              ]),
            );
            result.total = Object.values(result).reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
            return result;
          };

          const before = readJson("before.json");
          const after = readJson("after.json");
          const summary = {
            before: counts(before),
            after: counts(after),
            fixExitCode: readExit("fix.exit"),
            auditExitCode: readExit("after.exit"),
          };
          console.log(JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));
          if (summary.fixExitCode !== 0 || summary.auditExitCode !== 0 || summary.after.total !== 0) {
            console.error(readFileSync(join(root, "fix.log"), "utf8"));
            console.error(readFileSync(join(root, "after.err"), "utf8"));
            console.error(JSON.stringify(after, null, 2));
            process.exit(1);
          }
          NODE

      - name: Commit only dependency remediation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          branch='security/dependabot-main-remediation-20260908-v2'
          unexpected="$({ git diff --name-only; git diff --cached --name-only; } | sort -u | grep -Ev '^(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|pnpm-workspace\.yaml|apps/[^/]+/package\.json|packages/[^/]+/package\.json)$' || true)"
          if [[ -n "$unexpected" ]]; then
            echo "Unexpected tracked changes:" >&2
            echo "$unexpected" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          git add -- \
            package.json \
            pnpm-lock.yaml \
            pnpm-workspace.yaml \
            ':(glob)apps/*/package.json' \
            ':(glob)packages/*/package.json'
          git rm .github/workflows/dependabot-main-remediation-v2.yml
          git diff --cached --check
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git commit -m "fix(security): resolve all Dependabot alerts on main"
          git pull --rebase origin "$branch"
          git push origin HEAD:"$branch"
